changelog:
Journal thread names now have to be reused rather than reinvented, because reading the record back
  searches on them — a thread renamed halfway through the week stops being findable as one thing. The
  skill body no longer names any particular runtime's tools.
summary: Your agent remembers how things have been going: dated state, an evening journal, dreams at night, and a way to read it all back. No scores — recency carries the meaning. Writes under inner-life/, plus a few lines into native memory that every later session sees.
